question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Arid
solution:
The correct answer is "**Dry**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
• **Arid**: (of land or a climate) having little or no rain; too dry or barren to support vegetation.
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
• **Damp: **slightly wet.
 
• **Lively**: full of life and energy; active and outgoing.
 
• **Dry: **free from moisture or liquid; not wet or moist.
 
• **Fertile: **(of soil or land) producing or capable of producing abundant vegetation or crops.
 
• As per the meaning of the given options, "**dry**" is the synonym of "arid".
 
 
• **Example: ***The weather forecast predicted that today would be** **a **dry **__day.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the word.
 
• **Arid**: (भूमि या जलवायु का) बहुत कम या कोई वर्षा नहीं होना; वनस्पति का समर्थन करने के लिए बहुत शुष्क या बंजर।
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
• **Damp:**** **थोड़ा गीला।
 
• **Lively**: जीवन और ऊर्जा से भरा हुआ; सक्रिय और निवर्तमान।
 
• **Dry:**** **नमी या तरल से मुक्त; गीला या नम नहीं।
 
• **Fertile:**** **(मिट्टी या भूमि का) प्रचुर मात्रा में वनस्पति या फसल पैदा करने या पैदा करने में सक्षम।
 
• As per the meaning of the given options, "**dry**" is the synonym of "arid".
